items.title: CAST Moves the Full TCP/IP Stack into Hardware at 100 Gbps
items.summary: CAST has introduced TCPIP-100G, a synthesizable intellectual-property core that implements a complete TCP/IP stack in hardware for ASICs and FPGAs. The core is designed to transmit and receive at up to 100 Gbps without depending on a host processor. That distinction is important: this is not simply a checksum engine or a network-interface&8230; Read More The post CAST Moves the Full TCP/IP Stack into Hardware at 100 Gbps appeared first on SemiWiki .

items.title: Deploying AI from pilot to production
items.summary: A successful AI pilot doesn’t guarantee successful deployment to the rest of an organization. According to Accenture’s Pulse of Change report (July 2026), only 23% of C-suite leaders report having achieved sustained, enterprise-wide impact with AI initiatives. Pilots are designed for success. Teams are handpicked, often selected for enthusiasm and capability, and work on a defined scope with clear timelines. Pilot budgets are often protected, with insulation from normal organizational dynamics. This makes pilots unrepresentative of the conditions under which AI programs run in production. Accenture’s September 2026 Tokenomics research found that 42% of organizations rely on shared IT and finance accountability, with no single owner responsible for AI costs and outcomes.
